segments.he:
(שָׁם):
תקסא
(קיח) שָׁמַעְתִּימִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁכָּל יוֹם יֵשׁ לוֹ שֶׁפַע שֶׁלּוֹ
segments.en: (132.) I found one discourse in the name of Rabbainu o.b.m. from the writing of the friends. And this discourse was said on parshas Ekev 5566. And the essence of the matter: when a person needs counsel, he should ask counsel from tzaddikim, or from their disciples, or at least from the children of tzaddikim etc. — see there. And through this all harsh judgments are sweetened and one merits to be saved from sufferings — so that they do not come upon him at all. And even if, G-d forbid, the sufferings do come upon him — one merits through this...
